sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gladiator Doping - Part 3 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You know, you can actually avoid injuries altogether. Sounds like science fiction, I know, but at the very least we've got something that wont let blood loss finish you off. You've got access to that stimulant now, so go give it a try!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 30 enemies while under the effect of the Perfotoran stimulant

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Requirement | Notes |
| Perfotoran (Blue Blood) stimulant injector | Required | Hast to be active while making the kills |
